title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella on offering buyouts to 60,000 workers
excerpt: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explained his decision to offer voluntary buyouts to 60,000 employees instead of executing massive layoffs.
body_html:
Microsoft Chief Executive Officer Satya Nadella has discussed the reasoning behind a major workforce decision made in October. The company offered voluntary buyouts to 60,000 employees, effectively encouraging them to quit rather than carrying out another large-scale round of traditional layoffs.

According to Nadella, the motivation behind this approach was connected to artificial intelligence, though not in the way many might typically assume.
